question: Under what condition does the act of applying meditation follow upon worship of the circle in this prescribed sequence?
premises: Worship of the circle must precede the application of meditation.
The duration of meditation is limited by the temporal condition stated.
The practitioner actively applies meditation after completing the act of worship.
inference: Meditation is applied for as long as the prescribed temporal condition holds after worshipping the circle.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as the condition holds.
